purpose: C04 alternative method development and decision, NOT approved qualification

alternatives.name: Skewness-corrected Studentized CPI upper CI
alternatives.cost: O(G) statistics per independent trial; 184320000 CPI-count samples for 15x3000x4096 qualification
alternatives.theory: First-order Studentized Edgeworth/Cornish-Fisher correction; asymptotic, NOT finite-sample guaranteed
alternatives.risk: rare event extreme skew, unstable gamma, must prospectively re-qualify across all original 15 conditions
alternatives.pilot: 250 outer runs each of 15 conditions, exploratory and not a coverage qualification

alternatives.name: Whole-CPI bootstrap-t
alternatives.cost: O(B*G) per CI; B=2000 yields 368640000000 resampled CPI indices in 15x3000 formal qualification
alternatives.theory: Studentized bootstrap often second-order accurate for smooth statistics given regularity; not exact in sparse or degenerate counts
alternatives.pilot: 80 outer runs x256 bootstrap each in 4 scenarios only; too small for qualification
alternatives.risk: CPU cost, zero bootstrap variance and large right tail

alternatives.name: Distribution-free bounded CPI empirical Bernstein/Hoeffding
alternatives.theory: Independence across CPI plus Xi in [0,1] sufficient, arbitrary dependence within CPI; conservative finite-sample confidence
alternatives.risk: At 4096 CPI empirical Bernstein penalty alone >0.0015 so Pfa upper acceptance cannot PASS even with zero counts
